rules.text: If the pie-slice inscriptions are the dashboard's intended market-share values for the region named in the chart title, and “current market leader” means the brand with the largest displayed market-share value, then the brand whose displayed percentage exceeds every other displayed brand percentage is the option to select for follow-up.
rules.conditions: This bridge relies on the printed slice labels accurately encoding comparable current smartphone market shares for Europe and on the task using displayed market-share leadership as its criterion.
